about_the_game:
In this demo you can play the first rounds of the campaign, including the battles that ensue. This will give you an impression of what to expect in the release version.

Please note that mod support does not work in the demo!

In Roma Invicta, you have the honor of conquering ancient Gaul with the Roman legions. The game combines action-oriented real-time battles with turn-based strategy on the campaign map, where you raise, supply and move armies

The game can best be described as a mixture of the old Amiga classic “North and South” and the “Total War” series.

Features

  • Experience a lovingly handcrafted scenery of ancient Gaul.

  • Recruit your troops from legionnaires to scorpion artillery to Germanic cavalry.

  • Fight in tactical and action-packed real-time battles with hundreds of individual soldiers.

  • Slow down or pause the battle to always stay in control and give orders with no hurry.

  • Hand over parts of your army to the AI ​​to always keep control even in larger battles.

  • Supply your troops and always pay attention to the changing of the seasons.

  • You decide whether to bring peace to the Gallic villages or whether to plunder them and thus further ignite the resistance against you.

  • Different starting conditions and difficulty levels ensure replay value.

  • Support a hobby game developer in his first commercial game, all done by himself.

content_descriptors.notes: Ancient battles are depicted in pixel style. Soldiers can die and you can also see blood. This can be deactivated in the options.

short_description: Roma Invicta combines action packed real-time battles with turn-based strategy on a big campaign map. Supply your legions and conquer ancient Gaul turn by turn. Fight by yourself or hand over your soldiers to the AI ​​and enjoy the spectacle.
